objective: JEV query cross entropy; no contrastive or reconstruction auxiliary loss
selection: Equal-dataset validation-subject BAcc; ties keep earlier checkpoint including step 0
policy: CNAPS-inspired amortized feature adaptation using DeepSets plus FiLM; not a CNAPS reproduction. Source train subjects only for episodic optimization. No per-user gradient steps. One seed and one final exploratory test subject; no all-subject sweep.
freeze_policy: All JEV parameters including existing language LoRA, connector, choice head and original Tower buffers frozen. Tower full arm updates all forward Tower weights, preserving eval-mode BN/dropout in both arms.

query_policy.bcic_2a: T session support, E session query
